title: VRP Conformance Report v0.1
description: Score-free record of one run of one verifier (engine) against one named VRP conformance corpus. It carries per-vector outcomes, the reproducibility binding (engine, corpus digest, configuration, environment, run instant) and at least one declared must-fail control. It is not a trust, safety, compliance, certification or whole-agent verdict. It is not a score, a ranking, a registry of nodes, or a catalogue.

engine.description: The verifier under test. `source` and/or `digest` MUST identify the exact code that ran; a name and version alone are not reproducible.

corpus.description: The vector set that was run, as a repository path plus a content digest. One report covers exactly one corpus; do not merge corpora into one report.

config.description: Every input that could change an outcome and is not part of the corpus itself: injected clock source, key resolution, exclusions. Empty object means the engine ran with no options.

run_at.description: UTC instant the run started (RFC 3339, Z suffix).

results.description: One entry per vector in the corpus, including vectors that were not run. Missing evidence, a failed control or unavailable infrastructure is `inconclusive` or `void`, never `pass`.

must_fail_controls.description: Declared controls the engine MUST reject. A control whose `observed` outcome is anything other than `reject-as-required` shows the harness cannot distinguish the behavior; the report is then `discriminates: false` and no aggregate may be published.

discriminates.description: true only when every declared must-fail control was observed as `reject-as-required`.

aggregate.description: Optional. Counts only; no score, no weight, no percentile. `denominator` is always the full corpus size. Only `pass` and `reject-as-required` count as distinguished. `not-exercised`, `inconclusive` and `void` can never raise `distinguished`. The aggregate is not a trust, safety, compliance, certification or whole-agent verdict.

reporter.description: Who ran it. Free text; a report is evidence about a run, not an endorsement of the reporter.

method.description: How the digest was produced, precisely enough to recompute it. For a directory corpus: `sha256sum` manifest of the sorted (LC_ALL=C) *.json file names, then sha256 of that manifest text.

expected.description: The vector's own `expected` block, copied verbatim.

observed.description: What the engine returned, in the same shape as `expected`. Null members mean the engine did not evaluate that member.
